**2. Which sectors are leading?**

Materials showing strength: DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +16.18% | 1M: +36.25%), NEM RECOVERY (1W: +5.07% | 1M: -20.52%). Consumer Staples mixed but supporting the tape via MO RECOVERY (1W: +5.83% | 1M: -1.30%). Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5). Style: Value/Cyclical favored.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Technology lagging: GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -9.46% | 1M: -12.21%), META BELOW TREND (1W: -11.20% | 1M: -17.18%), MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -6.28% | 1M: -8.60%). Consumer Discretionary weak: TSLA BELOW TREND (1W: -6.71% | 1M: -11.73%), AMZN BELOW TREND (1W: -4.37% | 1M: -4.31%). Industrials under pressure: CAT BELOW TREND (1W: -4.88% | 1M: -10.15%).

Note minor divergence: MO, KHC, NEM showing RECOVERY (1W up vs 1M down) — short-term bounces, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**

Sector 1W: -6.44% (24 stocks) — watch for further distribution on heavy headline risk.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials soft and not leading: JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.12% | 1M: -5.50%), V BELOW TREND (1W: -1.61% | 1M: -6.43%), MA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.28% | 1M: -4.49%). Sector 1W: -2.02% (20 stocks) — negative breadth supports the RISK-OFF call.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare mixed-to-weak: PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +0.43%), JNJ RECOVERY (1W: +3.00% | 1M: -2.39%), LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -2.63% | 1M: -15.72%). Sector 1W: -0.14% (17 stocks) — defensive names showing selective strength but overall soft.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor exposure to Energy and Materials leaders (XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +12.44%), DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +16.18% | 1M: +36.25%)) and selective defensive Healthcare (PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +0.43%)); reduce exposure to large-cap Tech where losses are broad (GOOGL, META, MSFT BELOW TREND). Style: Value/Cyclical over Growth while RISK-OFF grips the market.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +16.18% | 1M: +36.25%), OXY ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.83% | 1M: +25.39%), XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +12.44%) — momentum and earnings/news sensitivity.  
BEARISH: META BELOW TREND (1W: -11.20% | 1M: -17.18%), GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -9.46% | 1M: -12.21%), ASML BELOW TREND (1W: -8.44% | 1M: -13.55%) — headline-driven downside to monitor.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +4.92% | 1M: +15.24%) and Materials (1W: +3.00% | 1M: -6.88%) for continuation of cyclical strength.  
BEARISH: Technology (1W: -6.44% | 1M: -6.81%), Consumer Discretionary (1W: -3.59% | 1M: -9.61%) as risk-off pressure persists.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch NVDA (BELOW TREND) for failure to reclaim last weekly range as a trigger for further downside; monitor AAPL (BELOW TREND) for a sustained weekly close above near-term resistance to signal stabilization; XOM (ABOVE TREND) to hold 1M trend support for continuation of cyclical leadership; JPM (BELOW TREND) weekly breakdown would reinforce Financials weakness.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**

MA (+55): MA BELOW TREND (1W: -1.28% | 1M: -4.49%) — positive news but price remains weak, watch for follow-through.  
PFE (not in top news list but showing strength): PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +0.43%) — price confirming select defensive interest.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
META (-80): META BELOW TREND (1W: -11.20% | 1M: -17.18%) — verdict-driven headline and heavy outflow, price confirms distribution.  
GOOGL (-80): GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -9.46% | 1M: -12.21%) — headline-aligned weakness, confirming risk.  
UNH (-50): UNH BELOW TREND (1W: -2.88% | 1M: -10.04%) — negative legal/breakup headlines align with price pressure; JPM (-45): JPM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.12% | 1M: -5.50%) — analyst pressure and price softness confirming risk.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF; Value/Cyclical style favored as Energy and Materials lead amid weak breadth (Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive). XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +12.44%) and DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +16.18% | 1M: +36.25%) showing relative strength. Largest risk is concentrated Tech downside and very bearish headlines on META/GOOGL (sentiment -80) that could broaden into a wider correction.
